# Introduction
You can edit this document with all the standard markdown syntax you are familiar with. Check out this [Markdown Guide](https://www.markdownguide.org/) for reference. 

In addition to basic Markdown, Quarto packs in a bunch of other powerful tools. Check out the [Quarto's Documentation](https://quarto.org/) for more information.

## Math

### In-Line Math
You can add inline math by using `$<text>$`: e.g. $E = mc^2$

### Block Equations
You can add block equations as follows by using
```md
$$
    <text>
$$
```
e.g.:
$$
    E = mc^2
$$

## Code Blocks
Example code block
```C++
#include <iostream>

int main() {
    cout << "hello world!\n";
    return 0;
}

```
